votes.motion: Councilor Hancock moved to adjourn into a closed session to discuss the     purchase, exchange, or lease of real property. Councilor Newall seconded the motion.
Approve an amendment to the Point Meadows CC&Rs.

Consideration of Resolution #2024-14 authorizing eminent domain proceedings at 2120 Triumph Blvd. Brad Kenison, Assistant City Engineer, informed the Council that this is a small portion of the 7-11 commercial property needed for the road widening project.

Consideration of Resolution #2024-15 approving an agreement with Huskie'z Landscaping for the mowing of various city properties. Steve Marchbanks, Parks and Facilities Manager, presented the agreement to the Council.

Consideration of Resolution #2024-13 adopting a Tentative Budget for the City of Lehi for Fiscal Year 2025. Dean Lundell, Finance Director, presented information on the tentative budget. He highlighted a projected $59.6 million in general fund revenue for the year. New allocations

Consideration of Resolution #2024-12 authorizing a tax certificate and agreement for UAMPS' Firm Power Supply Project; and related matters. Joel Eves, Power Director, explained the agreement to the Council, and noted that this is a prepayment option for power that’s only available to tax-exempt organizations like municipal
Consideration of Resolution #2024-11 approving a construction agreement with Strong Solutions for the construction of Shadow Ridge Park. Steve Marchbanks was available to answer questions.

Consideration of Ordinance #21-2024, the Lakeview Land and Rock General Plan amendment on 12.81-acres of property located at approximately 600 East 600 South, changing the land use designation from LDR (low density residential) to Heavy Commercial and Commercial.

Consideration of Ordinance #22-2024 a Zone change on 0.91-acres located at 498 North 900 East changing the zoning from RA-1 (residential/agriculture) to R-1-Flex (residential). Steve Atkinson was representing the applicant.

Consideration of Plat amendment approval for revisions to the Skye Preliminary Plat A, to include the Clubhouse parcel and surrounding lots and infrastructure. Jeff Stevenson was representing DR Horton’s application.
Consideration of Final subdivision approval for the River Point Phase 4 subdivision, a 70-unit subdivision located at approximately 3600 West 1100 North. Jed Stewart was representing Edge Homes.

Consideration of road name approval for roads located in Family Park- Hansen Ridge Drive and Family Park Drive. There was discussion about the naming of Family Park and that there may be potential for a different name.
